title: Cosmic Shattered Mage
description: A close-up portrait of a humanoid figure whose head is cracking apart like broken ceramic, revealing a swirling galaxy of stars and nebulae inside. The figure wears ornate, moss-covered armor with a high collar and holds glowing cosmic smoke and particles in an outstretched hand.
prompt: A mysterious humanoid mage with a cracked porcelain-like face revealing a vibrant galaxy and stars within, glowing purple eyes, ornate green moss-covered armor with intricate details, holding swirling cosmic smoke and glowing particles in his hand, ancient stone ruins with hanging moss and lanterns in the background under a starry night sky, highly detailed fantasy digital painting
